_notes: Protected launch config (Programmable launch-protection v1) for FluxPool's own token, read by script/FluxPlan.s.sol.

Pairs native ETH with a FluxProtectedToken on Ethereum mainnet. The whole supply is seeded as locked liquidity; the opening price (startTick) must value it at $15,000 or more against the canonical Chainlink ETH/USD feed.
router and usdFeed are the canonical addresses Programmable's policy fixes; their code hashes are read from the chain at plan time.

Zero addresses, "TBD" strings and 0 amounts are placeholders (Safe, operator, controller, developer, ticker, supply, start tick, initial buy, market-cap thresholds). The script refuses a real plan while any remain; DRY_RUN=true fills them with labelled values.
No ticker or contract address goes here until launch day (team rule).
